newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes sharply higher at 1,023.30.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes sharply higher at 1,023.30.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed sharply higher after getting a jolt from what interbank traders described as a surge in oil and coffee export revenues.
The local currency closed at 1,023.30 against the dollar, up 5.2 pesos from Monday's close.
"There was a lot of activity with coffee and oil and very little demand for (U.S. currency)," one trader said of the peso's steep gain.
Dealers reported 317 trades for a total of $116 million.
